title: 第9章技能休养第10章 虚浮血条
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
【清沙将军之巢】副本，为周元提供了一种思路。
村老的嘱托与翠娘前夫的遭遇，证明游戏怪物与副本，不是随着周元穿越才出现的，而是融入历史的现象。
这让他第一时间想到了城市、坞堡、寺庙、道观之类的建筑。
若是一个正常世界，城市大概率会建在交通便利或地形险要的地方。
寺庙与道观也会首选名川大山、风景秀丽的场所。
但这个世界有游戏怪物与游戏副本，建筑的所在位置就多了一层考量。
“如果我是本土人士，发现副本后无非有两种选择，一是保密、二是守护。
不过，保密的选项并不可靠，如果放任不管的话，总会有其他人意外进入。
选择守护虽然费时费力，但只要自身有一定的实力，就不会有人强闯庄园祠堂、地堡、书库之类的私密场所。”
当周元将游戏副本融入历史层面思考时，得出了一个既好又不好的结论。
好的是，他不需要像个无头苍蝇般的满世界探查副本了。
在长久的历史中便于发现的游戏副本，很可能都有了相应的主人或守护者。
不好的是，传承游戏副本的势力，很可能将副本当作自家最重要的财富。
他们不仅会想方设法的隐藏，还会拼尽全力的保护。
“大魏国，还有之前的朝代，这些不断更换的王朝，代代接替前朝遗产，游戏副本的积累必然不会少。”
周元发现他服兵役的目的又多了一个。
原本他只想着获得军营资源，现在又多了一个，混入朝廷探查游戏副本的理由。
对他来说，游戏副本不仅关乎到经验值的来源，更关乎到快速强化自身，甚至有几率接触到传说中的长生不死。
他来到这个世界后，严重缺乏安全感与社会地位，在有选择的情况下，他不会放任自己落魄困顿。
“真不知道这个世界的人会怎么利用游戏副本，又发展出什么样的奇特社会。”

周元曾向村中老者询问过‘科举’类的问题，但老者说没听过读了书，还能通过考试做官的。
大魏实行的是‘举荐制’，类似蓝星两汉时期的‘举孝廉’。
在这里王侯将相确实有种，家族没点势力，不可能有做官的机会。
周元本以为实行这样的制度，是因为生产力低下、知识传播途径有限。
现在游戏副本的现象告诉他，很可能是有副本作为传承的豪门大族杀之不绝。
在王朝变更断不了他们根的情况下，想让他们退出历史舞台，可就太难了。
拧干湿漉漉的衣服、提上陶罐，将六枚珍珠裹入腰带后，周元起身返回了自己家。
值班的赵大黄看到一个黑影推开院门后，忙伸出头吆喝。
“石头，再练会儿？”
“不练了，身子乏的很，今晚好好补补觉。”
“那感情好，你睡觉我就放心了，等天明我去给你整个鸡卵哄哄肚子。”
“要的，光吃饼子不顶饿。”
周元知道赵大黄惦记着一块吃肉的事儿，感觉占了晚辈的便宜，打算弄点实惠东西回报一番。
他没有拒绝赵大黄的好意，随口应下后，一头倒在了床上。
或许是明白了前进的方向，这一觉他睡得很沉很稳。
content_en:
The copy of [General Qingsha's Lair] provided Zhou Yuan with an idea.
The village elder's entrustment and Cuiniang's ex-husband's encounter prove that game monsters and copies did not appear with Zhou Yuan's time travel, but are phenomena integrated into history.
This made him immediately think of buildings such as cities, forts, temples, and Taoist temples.
In a normal world, cities would most likely be built in places with convenient transportation or difficult terrain.
Temples and Taoist temples also prefer places with famous mountains and beautiful scenery.
But there are game monsters and game copies in this world, so the location of the building has an extra layer of consideration.
"If I were a local, I would have two choices after discovering the copy, one is to keep it secret, and the other is to protect it.
However, the option to keep it secret is unreliable, and if left unchecked, there will always be someone else accidentally getting in.
Although choosing to guard is time-consuming and laborious, as long as you have a certain level of strength, no one will break into private places such as the manor's ancestral hall, bunker, and library. "
When Zhou Yuan integrated the game copy into historical thinking, he came to a conclusion that was both good and bad.
The good thing is, he doesn't need to explore the world like a headless fly.
Copies of the game that are easy to find over the long history are likely to have corresponding owners or guardians.
The bad thing is that the forces that inherit the copy of the game are likely to regard the copy as their most important asset.
Not only will they try their best to hide, but they will also do their best to protect.
"The Great Wei Kingdom, as well as the previous dynasties, these constantly changing dynasties have inherited the legacy of the previous dynasty from generation to generation, so the accumulation of game copies will inevitably be huge."
Zhou Yuan discovered that he had another purpose for serving in the military.
Originally, he only wanted to obtain military camp resources, but now he had another reason to sneak into the court to explore the game copy.
For him, the game copy is not only about the source of experience points, but also about quickly strengthening himself, and even having a chance to come into contact with the legendary immortality.
After he came to this world, he suffered from a serious lack of security and social status. If he had a choice, he would not let himself fall into poverty.
“I really don’t know how people in this world will use game copies and what kind of strange society they will develop.”
Zhou Yuan once asked an old man in the village about the 'imperial examination', but the old man said that he had never heard of anyone who could pass the exam and become an official after studying.
The Wei Dynasty implemented a ‘recommendation system’, similar to the ‘recommended filial piety and integrity’ system during the Han Dynasty.
The princes, generals and ministers here are indeed distinguished, but the family has no influence, so there is no chance of becoming an official.
Zhou Yuan originally thought that such a system was implemented because of low productivity and limited channels for knowledge dissemination.
The current phenomenon of game dungeons told him that it was probably the wealthy families who had dungeons as inheritance and were killing them endlessly.
It would be too difficult to get them to withdraw from the stage of history when dynasty changes cannot break their roots.
After wringing out the wet clothes, carrying the clay pot, and wrapping the six pearls into his belt, Zhou Yuan got up and returned to his home.
Zhao Dahuang, who was on duty, saw a dark figure pushing open the courtyard door and hurriedly stretched out his head and shouted.
"Shitou, will you practice a little longer?"
"I won't practice anymore. I'm very tired. I need to catch up on some sleep tonight."
"The relationship is good. I'll feel relieved while you sleep. I'll go and give you a whole egg to soothe your stomach in the morning."
"Yes, you won't feel hungry just eating pancakes."
Zhou Yuan knew that Zhao Dahuang was thinking about eating a piece of meat. He felt that he had taken advantage of the younger generation and planned to get something useful in return.
He did not refuse Zhao Dahuang's kindness, and after casually agreeing, he fell on the bed.
Perhaps because he understood the direction of progress, he slept deeply and peacefully.
